app.name: myquiz
app.tagline: Create quizzes, play live and download reports.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in to create and host games. Players don't need an account.

quizzes.title: My quizzes
quizzes.imported: The quiz was imported as a private draft.
quizzes.importFailed: The zip could not be imported. Fix these problems and try again:
quizzes.exportBlocked: "{{title}}" can't be downloaded yet: fix these so the zip can be imported again.
quizzes.retention: Quizzes are deleted from the server 3 weeks after they were last edited or played. Download a zip to keep a copy and import it again any time.
quizzes.confirmDelete: Delete "{{title}}"? An administrator can restore it within 30 days.

problems.question: question {{n}}
problems.TITLE_LENGTH: The title must be 1 to 120 characters.
problems.QUESTION_TEXT_LENGTH: Question text must be 1 to 300 characters.
problems.TIME_LIMIT: The time limit must be 5 to 240 seconds.
problems.OPTION_COUNT: A choice question needs 2 to 6 options.
problems.TRUE_FALSE_OPTION_COUNT: A true/false question needs exactly 2 options.
problems.OPTION_TEXT_LENGTH: Each option must be 1 to 120 characters.
problems.NO_CORRECT_OPTION: Mark at least one option as correct.
problems.TOO_MANY_CORRECT_OPTIONS: This question type allows exactly one correct option.
problems.ACCEPTED_ANSWER_LENGTH: Accepted answers must be 1 to 50 characters.
problems.BLANK_MARKER: Fill-in-the-blank text needs exactly one blank (___).
problems.DESCRIPTION_LENGTH: The description can be at most 1000 characters.
problems.ALT_TEXT_LENGTH: Image descriptions can be at most 300 characters.
problems.NOT_A_ZIP: The file is not a valid zip.
problems.TOO_MANY_FILES: The zip has too many files (at most 250).
problems.DUPLICATE: The zip contains duplicate file names.
problems.UNSAFE_PATH: The zip contains an unsafe path.
problems.SYMLINK: The zip contains a symbolic link.
problems.UNSUPPORTED_COMPRESSION: The zip uses an unsupported compression method.
problems.NAME_NOT_ALLOWED: File name not allowed; images go in the media folder.
problems.COMPRESSION_RATIO: A file is compressed suspiciously well.
problems.TOO_LARGE: The zip is too large unpacked (at most 100 MB).
problems.BAD_FORMAT: quiz.json is not a myquiz file.
problems.UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: The file is from a newer version than this server supports.
problems.MISSING_IMAGE: An image named in quiz.json is missing.
problems.NOT_AN_IMAGE: Not a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
problems.IMAGE_TOO_BIG: The image dimensions are too large.
problems.BAD_IMAGE_PATH: The image path is not valid.

errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.LOGIN_EXPIRED: The sign-in took too long; please try again.
errors.GOOGLE_UNAVAILABLE: Google could not be reached; try again later.
errors.GOOGLE_BAD_TOKEN: Google sent back something unexpected; please try again.
errors.EMAIL_UNVERIFIED: Your Google email address is not verified.
errors.DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED: This email address is not allowed to sign in.
errors.AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED: Google sign-in is not set up yet.
errors.CSRF_INVALID: Your session changed; please reload the page.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests; try again in a few minutes.
errors.IMPORT_BUSY: The server is busy importing; try again in a minute.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large (at most 25 MB).
